title: Finite module local models survive iterated inverse image
statement: On the coefficient-sized pro-etale sites of [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules], for composable scheme maps f and g, if inverse image along g of an A-module sheaf has finite locally constant models as in [def-pe-etale-constructible-module], then inverse image along f followed by g has the same property. No Noetherianity is required. The module also proves invariance under isomorphism.

source.place: part (1); local/classical detail for the finite stratification arguments

proof.text:
the two coefficient-site equivalences and scheme base change preserve finite
limits. The general site theorem preserves the same finite local models under inverse
image. Fibre-product pasting identifies composite base change; its direct-image
isomorphism has a unique adjunction mate identifying the two inverse images. Restrict
that isomorphism on every slice and compose with the pulled-back trivialization.
